# Domain Crawler

> A free online tool to crawl any website and generate a comprehensive SEO audit report.

## Overview

Domain Crawler (webcrawler.buzz) is a web-based domain crawling tool that scans entire websites using breadth-first search (BFS) and extracts page-level SEO data. It is completely free to use with no sign-up required.

## What It Does

Paste any URL and Domain Crawler will:
- Crawl every discoverable page on the domain
- Extract page titles, meta descriptions, HTTP status codes, response times, content types, page sizes
- Count internal and external links on each page
- Detect redirect chains and final redirect URLs
- Check indexability status of each page
- Generate a paginated, searchable results table
- Export results as CSV with email delivery

## Key Features

- Free website crawler — no registration, no limits on pages
- Real-time progress tracking with percentage updates
- Duplicate domain detection with option to re-crawl or view existing results
- Paginated results view (50, 100, 500, or 1000 results per page)
- CSV export with download link sent via email
- Email notifications when crawl completes
- Shareable tracking URLs — bookmark or share your crawl progress
- Mobile-friendly responsive design

## Use Cases

- SEO audits and website health checks
- Broken link detection (find 4xx and 5xx status codes)
- Site structure analysis via internal/external link counts
- Page speed analysis via response times
- Indexability verification across an entire domain
- Meta data auditing (missing titles, duplicate descriptions)
- Content type and page size analysis
- Website migration validation
